title: Check a proof of visit
description: A proof of visit confirms only that a SureCure Visit doctor visit took place. It never shows the patient, their address or any health details.
gatedTitle: Proof checks are not available yet

form.title: Check a code
form.label: Proof code
form.hint: The {length}-character code from the doctor. Spaces and dashes are ignored.
form.invalid: This is not a valid proof code. Check it and try again.

valid.title: This proof is valid
valid.body: A doctor visit took place on this date.

expired.title: This proof has expired
expired.body: Proofs work for a limited time. Ask the doctor or patient for a new one.

revoked.title: This proof was withdrawn
revoked.body: The doctor replaced or cancelled this proof. Ask for the current one.

unknown.title: We could not find this proof
unknown.body: Check the code for typing mistakes. A code that was never issued looks the same as a mistyped one.

result.limits: This check shows nothing about the patient or their health.
